Disease indicated as SPOAN, not ALS or FTD.","justification":"The dataset concerns SPOAN syndrome, a distinct hereditary neuropathy, not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples > Source Characteristics: Organism part: Skin fibroblast; Description: Fibroblast samples ...","justification":"Samples are skin fibroblasts (peripheral tissue), not human brain/CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples: Organism part: Skin fibroblast; Description: Fibroblast samples of 8 samples where analyzed: 4 SPOAN affected patients and 4 healthy controls.","justification":"The study uses patient-derived primary fibroblast cells (in vitro cell samples), which are non-CNS, patient-derived cellular material."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: Fibroblast samples of 8 samples were analyzed: 4 SPOAN affected patients and 4 healthy controls.","justification":"The design compares affected patients versus healthy controls (case/control groups of 4 each)."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples: Organism part: Skin fibroblast; no brain/CNS regions reported.","justification":"No brain regions sampled; skin fibroblasts are not regions affected by ALS-FTD neurodegeneration."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The technology is microarray-based RNA expression profiling, which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq or proteomics)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude. Although this is human microarray expression profiling with a case/control design, the dataset studies SPOAN syndrome (not ALS-FTD), uses patient-derived skin fibroblasts (non-CNS, in vitro), and thus does not meet disease or tissue inclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Study uses microarray-based transcription profiling on human-derived samples (Array assay, RNA)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title: hiPSC-derived motor neurons: sporadic ALS patients vs. controls; Experimental Factors > Disease: control, ALS.","justification":"Study compares sporadic ALS patient-derived samples to controls (ALS is within the ALS-FTD disease spectrum)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title/description: hiPSC-derived motor neurons from peripheral nerve fibroblasts; Sample attributes: Cell type/line lists fibroblasts from peripheral nerve, HEK 293; Organism part: Not found.","justification":"Samples are in vitro differentiated motor neurons from patient iPSCs (fibroblast-derived), not primary human CNS/brain tissue. No brain region samples reported. "},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title/description: hiPSC-derived motor neurons; Cell type/line: Fibroblasts from peripheral nerve; Cell line: HEK 293.","justification":"Study uses patient-derived iPSC-differentiated motor neurons (in vitro disease model) and cell lines, which meet exclusion criterion for non-clinical in vitro models. "},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: Two-condition experiment, ALS patients motor neurons vs. controls; Biological replicates: 3 ALS replicates, 3 control replicates; Experimental Factors: disease state.","justification":"Design compares disease (ALS) vs control groups with replicates (case/control)."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: Not found; samples are cell cultures (hiPSC-derived motor neurons) rather than brain region dissections.","justification":"No brain regions are sampled, so the question of irrelevant brain regions does not apply (dataset does not include brain-region samples)."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The platform is microarray-based (compatible); no RNA-seq or proteomics reported. "},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although the dataset is human and uses microarray profiling and has a case/control ALS design, it uses patient-derived iPSC-differentiated motor neurons and cell lines (in vitro disease model) rather than primary human CNS/brain tissue. This violates exclusion criterion 4 (in vitro disease models) and inclusion criterion 3 (requires CNS region tissue). Therefore the dataset should be excluded."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Microarray transcriptional profiling was performed on human samples (array/RNA assay), consistent with human microarray expression profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title/Description: study of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (tumour vs normal); Samples: tumour, normal from head and neck sites.","justification":"Samples are from head and neck mucosal/tumour tissues, not brain or other CNS regions."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Designs: in_vivo_design; Sample characteristics list tumour and normal tissues (no cell lines); Title/Description describe tumor tissue profiling.","justification":"Samples are in vivo tumor and normal tissues rather than patient-derived in vitro cell lines or disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Factors include DiseaseState: normal, tumour; Disease state/staging lists tumour and normal.","justification":"The design compares tumour (case) versus normal (control) samples, i.e., a case/control layout."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: oropharynx, larynx, tonsil, oral cavity (non-CNS tissues).","justification":"Tissues sampled are non-CNS head and neck sites, which are not regions affected by ALS-FTD neurodegeneration."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The study used microarray (array) technology, which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq/proteomics)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although this is a human microarray case/control study, it investigates head and neck squamous cell carcinoma using non-CNS tissues. It does not concern ALS-FTD or relevant CNS regions, so it fails the disease and tissue inclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Organism: Homo sapiens; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Title/Description: Microarrays of frontal cortex (area 8) of Parkinson cases and controls.","justification":"Dataset uses microarray-based transcription profiling on human samples (frontal cortex), meeting the human microarray expression profiling requirement."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples Disease/DiseaseState/DISEASESTATE: Parkinson's disease (and normal); Title/Description reference to Parkinson cases and controls.","justification":"Parkinson's disease is a Lewy body disease (part of the LBD spectrum), so the dataset pertains to LBD."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: frontal lobe; Title/Description: frontal cortex (area 8); Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Samples are human brain tissue (frontal cortex, area 8), i.e., CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples list shows organ/tissue (frontal lobe); Cell type/line: Not found; Title/Description and metadata indicate postmortem brain tissue rather than cell lines or models.","justification":"No indication of patient-derived in vitro cell lines or disease models; samples are tissue-derived."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: disease_state_design; Experimental Factors: DISEASESTATE with values Parkinson's disease and normal; Title: cases and controls; Sample count: 18.","justification":"Study compares Parkinson's disease cases to normal controls, i.e., a case/control design."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: frontal lobe (frontal cortex, area 8); Title/Description: frontal cortex (area 8).","justification":"Frontal cortex is a CNS region that can be involved in Lewy body pathology and relevant to LBD studies (cortical involvement in PD/LBD), so it is not an irrelevant region."},"q7_familial_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Clinical/familial metadata: Not found; DiseaseState values list Parkinson's disease and normal without familial annotation.","justification":"No information indicating the cohort is limited to familial LBD cases; appears to be sporadic PD cases."},"q8_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"Data were generated by microarray (array) technology, not RNA-seq or proteomics, so technology is compatible."},"q9_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Meets inclusion criteria: human microarray expression profiling of CNS tissue (frontal cortex) from Parkinson's disease (an LBD) cases and controls, with a case/control design; does not involve cell lines, familial-only cases, or incompatible technologies. Therefore suitable for inclusion."},"q10_include_dataset":{"answer":"Yes"}}

"},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 'A cell line comparison experiment for breast cancer 51 cancer cell lines'; Sample attributes: Cellline entries listed.","justification":"Dataset comprises in vitro human cancer cell lines (non-clinical models), meeting exclusion criterion for patient-derived cell lines/models. Although this is human microarray expression data, the study uses breast cancer cell lines (in vitro) rather than human CNS tissue and is not about Lewy body diseases.
